text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"February. With her target, the Osaka Hai, drawing near,
and morale high to defeat Silence Suzuka..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lately, trying to keep up with Air Groove's drive,
I've been spending longer hours working in the Trainer's Room.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That day, as I was working in the Trainer's Office after training with Air Groove—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's getting quite late...
You seem to really be pushing yourself.
choice_data_list: The "Osaka Hai" is getting close too, after all.
The "Osaka Hai" is getting close too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't overdo it. Your body is your greatest asset.
Collapsing when it counts won't do you any good.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
If so, that's fine.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I'll brew some tea.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You stay seated.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an atmosphere that brooked no refusal, I was forced to sit down.
Resigned, I continued working, when suddenly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—*plunk*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Along with a sweet aroma,
a single mug was placed on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What filled the mug was—
hot chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"—Drink. It's still chilly today,
and it should be just right for easing mental fatigue."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a sip as told, a pleasant sweetness
and rich aroma spread throughout, instantly
warming my body and filling me with happiness...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
Consider it a token of gratitude for everything you do on a daily basis.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Today is... that kind of day, after all. Consider this part of the annual tradition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Hearing Air Groove say that reminded me that today was Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Tomorrow starts early. I will take my leave now."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You had best savor every drop as you drink.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a night where Air Groove's thoughtfulness warmed both my heart and body...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A cup of coffee was placed on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And also... this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Sugar should do wonders for a tired brain.
Open it and eat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the wrapping... inside were
beautifully boxed chocolates lined up in a row.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing that, I suddenly
remembered that today is Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph, looks like you forgot after all.
Well, consider this a token of gratitude for everything you do for me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Stop staring and eat already.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As I ate a chocolate in front of Air Groove, a sweet yet bittersweet, rich flavor spread through my mouth—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Then very well.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Listen up. It's true that some flowers bloom beautifully precisely because of harsh soil. However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It does not mean one should simply push themselves to the brink in vain.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Many flowers occasionally require a gentle, nourishing rain...
Only by truly drawing strength from that blessing
will a grand bloom open when the day comes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—In short, don't push yourself too hard.
Eat some sweets and take a break now and then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And... you're doing well.
That's all.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I have an early start tomorrow.
I shall take my leave now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that Air Groove was just feeling shy,
and that's why she phrased it like that...?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Still, the chocolate she gave me clearly conveyed her thoughtful kindness,
leaving me with a warm feeling inside.
